choice.basis: The chart title is 'High fibre breakfast cereals vs Other breakfast cereals'. The left y-axis is labeled 'High fibre breakfast cereals' and corresponds to the red dashed line with square markers. The right y-axis is labeled 'Other breakfast cereals' and corresponds to the blue solid line with circular markers. At the '11-18 years' category, the red square marker (High fibre) is at the highest point of the red series, while the blue circular marker (Other) is at the lowest point of the blue series. Although the axes have different colors, the visual representation shows the 'High fibre' category having the dominant value (highest peak) for the 11-18 years group compared to the 'Other' category (lowest trough). This indicates that high-fibre cereals are the category of interest for follow-up in this age group.
choice.option_label: Route high-fibre breakfast cereals for 11-18 years to adolescent fibre-support follow-up
